label: Brooklyn Nets to win
why: Philadelphia are 11-3 but only +2.2 points per game, so the record flatters them; tonight they are on the second night of a back-to-back without LeBron James and with Embiid questionable on a sore foot. Brooklyn at home should be closer to 40% than 34%. What the price misses: The price looks anchored on Philadelphia's 11-3 record rather than their +2.2 point differential, and Embiid sitting the second night of a back-to-back is a real chance.

game: Portland Trail Blazers at Minnesota Timberwolves
label: Minnesota Timberwolves -2.5
why: Minnesota have built a +11.5 point differential and the best defense here while Edwards played only 4 of 13 games. At home against Portland, who are without Morant and Sharpe, they should be about 4 to 5 point favourites, not 2.5. What the price misses: Edwards' surgery last week reads as fresh bad news, but Minnesota's numbers were made almost entirely without him, so the price discounts them twice.

label: Washington Wizards +4.5
why: Last-ten form says Toronto by about 5 at home at full strength; take off about 2 for the back-to-back, about 3 for Scottie Barnes (out) and about 1 for RJ Barrett's hamstring, leaving Toronto by about 2. The 4.5-point spread and 64c price still look closer to a Toronto with Barnes. What the price misses: Toronto are on the second night of a back-to-back (known yesterday) and Scottie Barnes has since been ruled out with RJ Barrett questionable, yet the price only fell from 68c to 64c, about half of what Barnes alone is worth.
